findings.scope: Correctness of DP for largest pairwise-divisible subset
findings.claim: The algorithm returns the correct maximum size for the stated problem, including duplicates and unsorted inputs.
findings.reason: After sorting, any valid pairwise-divisible subset S can be ordered as a chain: for any two elements a<=b in S, divisibility of the pair forces a|b (b%a==0), since b%a==0 is the only possible direction. Thus S is a chain under divisibility, and the DP that extends dp[j] when nums[i]%nums[j]==0 finds the longest such chain. Conversely, any chain produced by the DP is pairwise divisible by transitivity: if earlier elements divide later ones along the chain, every pair divides. Duplicates are handled because equal values satisfy x%x==0 and can extend the chain. Empty input returns 0.
